proposal.capability: opt-in secret-safe structured Node.js crash diagnostics for process targets
proposal.implementation: Ferrum owns Node report flags, uses a temp report directory, rejects conflicting user report flags, retains only selected crash/stack/heap/resource/thread and endpoint-free libuv data through EvidenceWriter, deletes raw reports, records node-diagnostic-report evidence and nodeReports count
proposal.privacy: omits raw command line,cwd,hostname,environmentVariables,networkInterfaces,localEndpoint,remoteEndpoint,sharedObjects; existing EvidenceWriter secret redaction still applies
proposal.acceptance: real uncaught Node error exits 1, yields one retained report, stack identifies intentional error, injected secret absent, sensitive/raw endpoint fields absent, conflicting --report-directory rejected before launch
proposal.remainingGate: exact head must pass all required CI/runtime jobs before merge

primarySourceDecision.facts: structured JSON reports; uncaught-exception/fatal-error triggers; --report-exclude-env removes environmentVariables; --report-exclude-network suppresses network-interface data and endpoint host resolution; Ferrum additionally strips unnecessary endpoint/host/account details
